system.description:
Like many among your Species, you know how to blend in with galactic society, using your natural gregarious disposition to keep others off guard.

Prerequisite: Sullustan

Effect: Whenever you successfully use the Change Attitude application of the Persuasion Skill to change a target's Attitude, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all Deception or Persuasion checks against that target for the next 24 hours.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
